How many days do you need on Koh Samui? | Five to seven days is ideal: enough for the round-island loop, two boat days (Ang Thong or Pig Island, plus Koh Tao) and a slow beach or spa day. With 10 days you can add Koh Phangan and a night inside Ang Thong Marine Park.
Is 3 days enough for Koh Samui? | Yes, for the highlights: one evening at Fisherman's Village, one boat day (Ang Thong from 16 December to 31 October, Pig Island on any date) and one round-island day with Big Buddha, Wat Plai Laem, Hin Ta and Hin Yai, Wat Khunaram and Na Muang Waterfall.
What is the best day trip from Koh Samui? | Ang Thong Marine Park by speedboat (1,800 THB plus 300 THB park fee) for limestone islands, kayaking and the Emerald Lake, from 16 December to 31 October. From 1 November to 15 December, or for a shorter day, the Pig Island and Koh Tan speedboat tour (1,450 THB, 4–5 hours) runs all year.
Can I do Ang Thong and Koh Tao on the same trip? | Yes, on separate days: each is a full day trip from Samui (Ang Thong about 8 hours, Koh Tao about 8–9 hours) and tour boats return to Samui each evening. Put a land day between them if you can, and remember Ang Thong is closed from 1 November to 15 December.
Can I follow this itinerary in November? | Yes, with swaps: Ang Thong is closed from 1 November to 15 December, so replace it with Pig Island, keep Koh Tao early in your stay in case the sea is rough, and use the rainy-day ideas on wet afternoons. On 24 November 2026 the Full Moon Party and Loy Krathong fall on the same night.
Should I plan around the Full Moon Party? | Only if you want to go. The next dates are 24 November, 24 December and 31 December 2026, then 22 January and 22 February 2027. Book the shared speedboat (1,400 THB return with Samui hotel pickup) early, and don't schedule a boat tour for the morning after.
Can I visit Khao Sok from Samui in a day? | No. Khao Sok is 4–6 hours each way from Samui (ferry to Donsak plus about 190 km by road), so a day trip would be almost all travel. Plan at least 2 days and 1 night, or visit it before or after Samui.
Can I see the island without renting a scooter? | Yes. Boat tours include hotel pickup from most areas, Grab covers Chaweng, Bophut and Lamai, and a full-day taxi for the round-island loop costs about 2,000–3,000 THB. Songthaews run along the ring road by day for 30–80 THB.
